:module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_s3_object.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The module already has an implicit dependency on :resource.aws_s3_object.this because its Helm configuration references aws_s3_object.this.key; the explicit depends_on entry duplicates that ordering.
aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng references aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn for node_role_arn, so the explicit dependency on the role duplicates the implicit dependency.
null_resource.update_trust_policy interpolates aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id in its command, already creating an implicit dependency on this role; the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
null_resource.update_trust_policy interpolates kubernetes_namespace.spark.id in its command, already creating an implicit dependency on the namespace; the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

The RoleBinding refers to the per-team Role by a computed literal name but has no dependency edge to that Role. Terraform may create the binding first, so wire the role_ref name to the Role resource (or add depends_on) to ensure the referenced RBAC role exists first.

The ClusterRoleBinding refers to the per-team ClusterRole by a computed literal name but has no dependency edge to that ClusterRole. Wire role_ref.name to the ClusterRole resource (or add depends_on) so the referenced RBAC role is created first.

aws_s3_object.this can be created before the bucket's default server-side encryption configuration is applied. Since the object is created without an explicit encryption setting, it may be stored unencrypted; ensure the bucket encryption configuration is in place before creating the object.
